# bash_allow.txt — commands that MUST end in Allow under tier 1+2 only
# (no LLM, no cache, no legacy). One command per line. Lines starting
# with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# These exercise the deterministic instant_allow rules. Every command
# here is a "shape that's anchored, no shell trickery, in the allow
# program list". Catches regressions when allow rules tighten or
# break.

# --- POSIX read-only family ---
ls
ls -la
ls -la /tmp
cat /etc/hosts
head -10 /var/log/system.log
tail -5 /tmp/test.log
wc -l /tmp/test.log
grep foo /tmp/test.log
grep -r foo /tmp
find /tmp -type f
find /tmp -name '*.log'
which python3
whereis ls
file /tmp/test
stat /tmp/test
du -sh /tmp
df -h
printenv PATH
echo hello
echo "hello world"
echo hello world
date
pwd
whoami
hostname
uname -a
id

# --- Text/data inspection ---
jq .
yq .
cmp /tmp/a /tmp/b
diff /tmp/a /tmp/b
xxd /bin/ls
od -c /tmp/file
hexdump /tmp/file

# --- Git read-only subcommands ---
git status
git log
git log --oneline
git log -n 5
git diff
git diff main
git diff HEAD~1
git show
git show HEAD
git branch
git branch -a
git remote
git remote -v
git blame /tmp/file
git rev-parse HEAD
git ls-files
git ls-tree HEAD
git describe
git config user.name

# gcloud is intentionally NOT in tier 2 (its subcommand tree is too
# deep for anchored_command). gcloud calls fall through to the LLM
# tier — see bash_continue.txt.

# --- bq read-only ---
bq show
bq ls
bq query
bq head

# --- terraform read-only ---
terraform plan
terraform validate
terraform fmt
terraform show
terraform version
terraform output
terraform workspace
terraform console

# --- docker / podman read-only ---
docker ps
docker images
docker inspect foo
docker logs foo
docker version
docker info
podman ps
podman images

# --- kubectl read-only ---
kubectl get
kubectl get pods
kubectl describe
kubectl logs foo
kubectl version
kubectl cluster-info
kubectl explain

# --- go safe subcommands ---
go version
go env
go list
go vet
go fmt
go doc
go help

# --- node package managers, read-only ---
npm list
npm ls
npm view foo
npm outdated
npm audit
npm config list
npm whoami
yarn list
yarn outdated
pnpm list

# --- gh read-only outer subcommands (note: 'gh pr merge' is not safe but is gated by LLM tier 4 / user prompt) ---
gh pr
gh issue
gh repo
gh run
gh api
gh auth
gh release
gh search
gh status
gh version
gh help

# --- make read-only targets ---

# --- step 1 regression: gh reads still instant-allow via gh-readonly ---
gh pr view 42
gh pr list
gh issue list
gh repo view foo/bar
gh api /user
gh api -X GET /user

# --- step 3: git config reads (stay instant_allow via git-readonly) ---
git config
git config user.name
git config --list
git config --global --list
git config --get user.email
git config --get-all remote.origin.url
git config --get-regexp ^alias
git config --show-origin user.email

# --- step 3: git remote reads (stay instant_allow via git-readonly) ---
git remote
git remote -v
git remote show origin
git remote get-url origin

# --- blocker 3: ssh-add regression — ssh family still reads keys ---
